faqs.question: Does Field support theming?
faqs.answer: Yes. Choose an appearance and override the paired --zui-field-* light and dark CSS variables.

sections.heading: What it does
sections.body: A field wrapper that associates a label, description, and error with a native or custom control.

sections.heading: API
sections.body: Compose labels, descriptions, errors, and required state around any form control.

sections.heading: Accessibility
sections.body: The render callback supplies the control ID and ARIA description and error references; Fieldset uses a native legend.

sections.heading: Next.js integration notes
sections.body: Import the static subpath in a Client Component when interactive state is needed.
